name: NAS-Bench-NLP
description: A benchmark for neural architecture search in natural language processing, providing a search space of recurrent neural networks trained on text datasets with precomputed performance results to enable reproducible experiments and evaluation of NAS algorithms.
reputation: A well-known NAS benchmark in NLP research for reproducible architecture search experiments, though it is more commonly used by the NAS community than as a general benchmark leaderboard target.
notes: Focuses on recurrent architectures for NLP and provides precomputed results for 14k architectures.
